note: Lesson is the خرب / خرّب (get-ruined vs make-ruined) verb, 15:27-57:56, then N-verb recall. Many Medi lines 18:14-36:36 are '[speaking Arabic]' holes, so several disputes rest on Amal's side only. From 40:45 on the transcript is Latin-transliterated. The engine renders في as هي (26:17), ح as ه (25:04 بهتي = بحطي) and drops/merges short vowels, so single-word 'wrong form' rows (مزيد, الغرف, بارد) are kept only at low confidence for Amal to confirm. Three separate fixes live in the 56:25-56:55 soup sentence (no b- after راح; one T not two = make- not get-ruined; object -ها) - D17 and D18 together cover all three (D18 carries bucket2 D4), so r2's D4 reading inside D17 is not lost.
